chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Ali ibn Ma'bad from al-Husayn ibn Khalid from Abi'l-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever is a Muslim should not scheme or deceive others, for surely, I heard Gabriel (peace be upon him) say: 'Scheming and deception are in the Fire.'

key_terms.الْمَكْرَ وَالْخَدِيعَةَ: Scheming and deception: two forms of dishonesty explicitly condemned as leading to Hellfire

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about scheming and deception in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), narrated through Imam al-Rida (AS) from his forefathers, warns that a Muslim must never scheme or deceive, as Gabriel (AS) confirmed that scheming and deception lead to Hellfire. This prophetic tradition emphasizes that deceit is fundamentally incompatible with Islamic faith.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
